arxiv-1804-10274.title: Is the universe static?
arxiv-1804-10274.creator: David F. Crawford
arxiv-1804-10274.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by David F. Crawford. A fundamental property of an expanding universe is that any time dependent characteristic of distant objects must appear to scale by the factor ( 1 + z CLOSE (1+z ). This is called time dilation. Light curves of type Ia supernovae and the duration of Gamma-Ray Bursts (GRB) are the only observations that can directly measure time dilation over a wide range of redshifts.

arxiv-2212-09797.title: 21cmfish: Fisher-matrix framework for fast parameter forecasts from the cosmic 21-cm signal 2023 21cmfish: Fisher-matrix framework for fast parameter forecasts from the cosmic 21-cm signal – References
arxiv-2212-09797.creator: Charlotte A. Mason, Julian B. Muñoz, Bradley Greig, Andrei Mesinger, and Jaehong Park
arxiv-2212-09797.description: Abstract The 21-cm signal from neutral hydrogen in the early universe will provide unprecedented information about the first stars and galaxies. Extracting this information, however, requires accounting for many unknown astrophysical processes. Semi-numerical simulations are key for exploring the vast parameter space of said processes.

arxiv-2307-12912.title: Classical simulation of non-Gaussian fermionic circuits
arxiv-2307-12912.creator: Beatriz Dias, Robert König
arxiv-2307-12912.description: Abstract We propose efficient algorithms for classically simulating fermionic linear optics operations applied to non-Gaussian initial states. By gadget constructions, this provides algorithms for fermionic linear optics with non-Gaussian operations. We argue that this problem is analogous to that of simulating Clifford circuits with non-stabilizer initial states: Algorithms for the latter problem immediately translate to the fermionic setting.

arxiv-2410-02532.title: CUDA-based optical parametric oscillator simulator
arxiv-2410-02532.creator: A. D. Sanchez, S. Chaitanya Kumar, M. Ebrahim-Zadeh
arxiv-2410-02532.description: Abstract The coupled-wave equations (CWEs) in nonlinear optics are the fundamental starting point in the study, analysis, and understanding of various frequency conversion processes in dielectric media subjected to intense laser radiation. In this work, a useful package for the modeling of optical parametric oscillators (OPOs) based on the Split-Step Fourier Method algorithm is presented.

arxiv-2504-05250.title: PEAKS: Selecting Key Training Examples Incrementally via Prediction Error Anchored by Kernel Similarity
arxiv-2504-05250.creator: Mustafa Burak Gurbuz, Xingyu Zheng, Constantine Dovrolis
arxiv-2504-05250.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mustafa Burak Gurbuz, Xingyu Zheng, Constantine Dovrolis. As deep learning continues to be driven by ever-larger datasets, understanding which examples are most important for generalization has become a critical question. While progress in data selection continues, emerging applications require studying this problem in dynamic contexts. To bridge this gap, we pose the Incremental Data Selection (IDS) problem, where examples arrive as a continuous stream, and need to be selected without access to the full data source.

arxiv-2505-02908.description: Abstract We present early multi-wavelength photometric and spectroscopic observations of the Type IIb supernova SN 2024uwq, capturing its shock-cooling emission phase and double-peaked light curve evolution. Early spectra reveal broad H α \alpha ( v ∼ 15,500 v\sim 15,500 km s -1 ) and He I P-Cygni profiles of similar strengths.

pmc-11409971.title: Clock protein LHY targets SNAT1 and negatively regulates the biosynthesis of melatonin in Hypericum perforatum
pmc-11409971.creator: Wen Zhou, Ru-Yi Xiao, Yi-Xiao Yang, Xue Wang, Dong-hao Wang, Zhe-zhi Wang
pmc-11409971.description: Hypericum perforatum, also known as “natural fluoxetine,” is a commonly used herbal remedy for treating depression. It is unclear whether melatonin in plants regulated by the endogenous circadian clock system is like in vertebrates. In this work, we found that the melatonin signal and melatonin biosynthesis gene, serotonin N-acetyltransferase HpSNAT1, oscillates in a 24-hour cycle in H. perforatum.

pmc-11493648.title: Long term outcomes of pituitary adenomas in Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia type 1: a nationwide study
pmc-11493648.creator: Nuria Valdés, Ana Romero, Estrella Diego, María Calatayud, Cristina Lamas, Marta Araujo-Castro, Cristina Álvarez-Escolá, José A. pmc-11493648.description: IntroductionHistorically, Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia type 1 (MEN1)-related pituitary adenomas (PAs) were considered more aggressive and treatment-resistant than sporadic PAs. However, recent studies suggest similarities in their behavior. This study aimed to evaluate the long-term outcomes of MEN1 PAs and identify predictive factors.

pmc-12469981.description: Background: Tobacco use remains a major public health concern among young adults and is often complicated by co-occurring addictive behaviors. pmc-12634963.title: Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors and Interstitial Lung Disease: A Disproportionality Analysis Using the European Post-marketing EudraVigilance Database

pmc-12634963.description: BackgroundIncreasing global frequency of drug-induced interstitial lung disease (ILD) coincides with increasing market introduction of tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs).ObjectivesThe aim was to detect disproportional reporting of TKI-induced ILD in the EudraVigilance post-marketing safety database and to scrutinise the prescribing information of these TKIs.

pmc-13183082.title: M2 macrophage-associated factors for constructing a prognostic model for osteosarcoma
pmc-13183082.creator: Jian Han
pmc-13183082.description: Background:Osteosarcoma (OS) is a common clinical malignant bone tumor. This study aimed to identify M2 macrophage-associated factors to construct a prognostic model for OS.Methods:The osteosarcoma-related profiles including expression data and clinical information were obtained from TCGA and NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus, respectively. The M2 macrophage-associated differentially expressed RNAs (DERs) were identified between metastasis and nonmetastasis samples.

pmc-13682071.title: Student perceptions of technology-enhanced simulation resources in laparoscopic training: a scoping review and implications for surgical instrumentation
pmc-13682071.creator: Arley Denisse Vega Ochoa, Hannys Liseth Pinto Bautista, Wendis Johana Weber Ipuana, María de los Ángeles González Cuello, Anderson Díaz Pérez
pmc-13682071.description: BackgroundLaparoscopic training increasingly uses technology-enhanced simulation resources, including virtual reality, augmented reality, box trainers, portable trainers and digital surgical curricula. In this review, these resources are analysed as technology-enhanced simulation resources rather than as uniformly “emerging” technologies, because some tools, particularly box trainers, are established components of laparoscopic education.
